description: Source code implementation of the Poly1305 message authentication code (MAC) algorithm, including functions for initialization, updating with data, and finalization to produce the MAC. Contains platform-specific optimizations and internal cryptographic operations.

methods.name: CRYPTO_poly1305_init
methods.description: Initializes the Poly1305 state with a 32-byte key, precomputing multipliers and setting initial state values.

methods.name: CRYPTO_poly1305_update
methods.description: Updates the Poly1305 state with input data, buffering partial blocks and processing complete 16-byte blocks.

methods.name: CRYPTO_poly1305_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the MAC computation, performs modular reduction, and outputs the 16-byte MAC.
